content.value: A valley curve is divided by descending grade of 1 in 30 meeting an (12) ascending grade of 1 in 25. Design the length of valley curve to fulfill both comfort condition and head light sight distance requirement for a design speed of 80 kmph. Assume allowable rate of change of centrifugal acceleration. C=0.6 m/sec³
